Information.Name: Default App Settings
Information.Description: This is the default Settings manager definition file for FPCA.
Information.Author: Frysix

AlwaysKeepOnTop.Description: Keep the main window always on top of other windows

AlwaysTryFirst.Description: From where to always try to get updates first

TransferSettings.Description: Transfer settings to the new version during update

TransferMods.Description: Transfer mods to the new version during update

TransferPortableApps.Description: Transfer portable apps to the new version during update

RestartAfterConfig.Description: Restart the computer after running the configuration scripts

RunCaffeine.Description: Aquire and Run Caffeine to prevent the system from sleeping during configuration

RestartReminderDefaultMins.Description: Default minutes to remind the user to restart the computer after configuration

SelfDeleteTickedOnByDefault.DisplayName: Self Delete Ticked On By Default
SelfDeleteTickedOnByDefault.Description: Tick the 'Delete on Exit' option by default in the configuration scripts

MainUiTimerInterval.Description: Interval in milliseconds for the main UI timer's tick event

InternetCheckUpdateCounter.Description: Number of main loop iterations between internet connectivity checks

MainFormLoadLoopCounter.Description: Maximum number of iterations to wait for the main form to load before timing out

SettingsOpResultCounterThreshold.DisplayName: Settings Operation Result Label's Presence Counter Threshold
SettingsOpResultCounterThreshold.Description: Number of main loop iterations to display the settings operation result message before clearing it

ConfigMainLoopRefreshRate.Description: Delay in milliseconds for each iteration of the configuration main loop

MainLoopRefreshRate.Description: Delay in milliseconds for each iteration of the main loop
